provenance: OfficeIMO-owned deterministic synthetic OOXML; no user documents, external fixture carriers or assets.
producer: Microsoft Word for Microsoft 365 16.0.20430.20182 on Windows
export: Read-only open and native PDF export with macros forced off; no repair, save, trusted location or external-field update. All source hashes remained unchanged.

native_synthesized_stories.content: A single separator or continuationSeparator mark in a run

native_observations: Absent typed separator stories were synthesized by Word using the recorded mark-only story profile.
The stored native-equivalent stories and absent-story base produced identical native page rasters.
Changing FootnoteText from Arial10/exact12 to Arial20/exact32 left native page rasters and fixed body/note glyph geometry unchanged.
Changing Normal from Arial12 to Arial18 changed separator glyph/rule ink; fixed body/note glyph geometry and pagination remained unchanged.
limits: This cohort qualifies these source/native pairs. It does not establish a generic allocated separator-height formula or a constant height.
Normal paragraph line height and document paragraph defaults were not varied independently; painted separator ink does not establish its allocated advance.
The explicit control is mark-only. Empty paragraphs, empty stories and zero-paragraph stories have no native-equivalence qualification from this cohort.

Native pagination requires the recorded Arial font programs. Portable checks cover retained content, source order, source immutability, frame admission and within-renderer geometry equivalence; no native-versus-converter coordinate budget is added.
